context.paragraph: runtime/capture.py#import_module delegates public standard-library imports to CPython, including time, math, json, and collections. It retains a browser-compatible facade for selected real asyncio APIs: run, sleep, gather, create_task, wait_for, current_task, get_running_loop, Task, Future, and CancelledError. On Emscripten, run uses a selector-loop subclass without the socketpair wakeup mechanism; the single worker supports cooperative tasks and timers, not socket or thread I/O. Native runs use the standard loop. Library frames remain opaque; user coroutine opcodes are observed normally.
